In summary, our research is concerned with
the hormonal and developmental regulation of the synthesis of glycoproteins in rat hepatocytes.
the synthesis and regulation of glycosylation of α 2u -globulin, an androgen-regulated plasma protein.
the regulation of the synthesis and secretion of the 20-kDa and the 40–45-kDa forms of α 1 -acid glycoprotein (AGP) by rat liver.

glycosylation and secretion of α 2u-globulins are regulated in the same manner by androgenic hormones and by aging.

the synthesis of α2u globulins is regulated by both hormonal and developmental mechanisms.

the synthesis of the glycosylated form is not regulated by androgens or estrogens, but rather, the synthesis of this form appears to be under the control of a developmental program.
